text:
maya (PM): quick sync — planning rollout strategy for regional steering feature. goal: let routing prioritize latency-sensitive tenants in EU first, then APAC. want conservative canary + A/B on quality.

devin (eng): sounds good. proposal: feature flag `regional_steer_v1` + two variants: `control` (current routing) and `steer_v1` (latency-aware).

sam (sre): ops constraints — EU GPUs limited. need circuit-breaker if latency > 300ms p50 or error rate spike. fallback should route to `control` model variant and degrade to cheaper quantized model if capacity low.

lia (prod-ops): rollout plan idea: 1) internal canary (10% traffic, internal tenants) for 24h; 2) EU external canary (1% of EU traffic) for 48h with metrics gate; 3) staged ramp to 10% then 50% over 7 days. A/B test will run in parallel for quality comparison.

ashok (data): define evaluation set up-front. we should run CTA-style prompts + 5k sampled user queries for quality delta. metric: user-facing regression <= 1% on perplexity/proxy OR no >2x increase in hallucination rate. store sample prompt set in /evals/regional_steer/seed_v1.

maya (PM): telemetry gates — latency p50, p95, token cost delta, failover rate, and regression on quality evals. thresholds: p50 <= 1.15x baseline, p95 <= 1.3x baseline, cost delta < 5%.

devin (eng): implementation notes: add flag scope by region + tenant_tag. Backend will return header X-Routing-Variant for tracing. we can use rollout API: `POST /flags/rollout {flag:regional_steer_v1, cohort:eu_canary, variant:steer_v1, pct:1}`.

sam (sre): add automatic fallback policy in the routing policy engine: if downstream error or high latency, flip request to fallback variant for N minutes and send alert. prefer soft-fallback first (serve quantized model) then hard-fallback (control).

lia (prod-ops): who owns the kill-switch? recommend ops owns immediate kill, eng and pm notified. add a safety window so kill toggles can't exceed 2x/min to avoid flapping.

devin (eng): canary tooling: deploy-bot will kick off canary run and post status. sample command: ```
deploy-bot: start-canary --flag regional_steer_v1 --cohort eu_internal --duration 24h --traces yes
```

deploy-bot: Canary started for regional_steer_v1 (eu_internal). correlators: #canary-eu-6790012345. Will post hourly stats.

ashok (data): for A/B: run side-by-side logging with tag `ab_regional_steer_v1`. make sure we capture both model outputs and latency headers, anonymized. need privacy check signoff.

maya (PM): customer gating — we have one pilot customer (Acme) who wants opt-in in EU. lia to coordinate opt-in contract clause. acme should be in the second stage EU external canary.

lia (prod-ops): noted, will add tenant opt-in list for cohort. also prepare rollback playbook and runbook for support.

sam (sre): ops checklist: throttles, circuit-breaker thresholds, alert runbooks, synthetic traffic to detect regressions, automated snapshot of pre-canary model weights for fast rollback.

devin (eng): one more: metric tagging to correlate by tenant_tier and region. Feature flag should support per-tenant override for enterprise tiers.

maya (PM): launch criteria summary: no critical alerts in 48h internal canary, EU canary quality gates pass, opt-in customer happy, rollback and kill-switch tested. if any gate fails, abort ramp.

ashok (data): I'll produce a quality report template and baseline numbers by EOD.

devin (eng): timeline: internal canary tomorrow 09:00 UTC, EU external canary Thu 09:00 UTC if internal green. lia — can you prep the opt-ins and runbook before tomorrow?

lia (prod-ops): yes, will prep and DM the pilot list + support doc.

maya (PM): thanks — I'll post the condensed playbook in the shiproom and assign owners. :thumbsup:

sam (sre): noted, will add synthetic probes and alert dashboards.

deploy-bot: hourly stats posted to #canary-eu-6790012345. next update in 60m. (reacted :eyes:)

devin (eng): small TODO: add `X-Routing-Variant` to audit logs and ensure log retention 30d for canary.

maya (PM): ok closing the sync — owners: eng (devin) for flag and fallback, ops (lia) for opt-in/runbook, sre (sam) for thresholds, data (ashok) for evals. will follow up in the shiproom doc.

lia (prod-ops): agree. ping if anything urgent.

sam (sre): if we see >10% fallback rate in first 2h, auto-kill. agreed?

maya (PM): agreed. we'll add that to the rollout policy.

devin (eng): noted, will implement the auto-kill rule in routing engine.

(threads ends)
